  interface Describable
    fun describe
  class Doc(val title: String), Describable
    fun describe
  struct Tag : Describable
    field v: Int
    fun describe
  fun isPresent<T>(value: T?): Boolean
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm Some(_)
          BoolLiteral true
        arm None
          BoolLiteral false
  fun main()
    val d
      Call Doc
        StringLiteral "report"
    Call println
      MethodCall describe
        Var d
    val i: Describable
      Var d
    Call println
      MethodCall describe
        Var i
    val t
      Call Tag
        IntLiteral 1
    val ti: Describable
      Var t
    Call println
      MethodCall describe
        Var ti
    val a: Any
      Var t
    Call println
      Is Tag false
        Var a
    Call println

        Cast Describable optional=true
